text:
leo (Finance): Heads up: monthly close showing a ~$27k negative line on account project:acme-trials. Looks like Marketplace credits were applied to our internal prod pool instead of the customer project. Can someone confirm?
billing-bot: Notification: credit-application-event id=cr-9921 applied amount=27750 currency=USD to resource=projects/redwood-prod/pools/prod-gpu at 2024-07-02T04:12:09Z.
maria (Billing): whoa. That bot entry suggests the credit got attached to `redwood-prod` resources. We normally apply partner/MKT credits to the partner billing_account.
anya (Partnerships): That's from the Acme partner trial agreement (acct:acme). We issued a credit code `ACME-TRIAL-2024` to their project. I routed redemptions to our marketplace integration webhook. Might be a mapping bug.
sam (CloudOps): The marketplace connector maps incoming webhook payloads -> GCP credit grants via service account. If the payload lacked `customer_project` we default to `owner_project` which for partner trials is `redwood-prod`.
leo (Finance): So default behavior caused Redwood to absorb $27.75k of partner credit. That underreports customer cost and artificially reduces our net spend. We need correction before invoicing.
maria (Billing): Short-term fix: we can reverse the credit on redwood-prod and re-issue to acme's project. Need the original transaction id and proof of intent.
anya (Partnerships): I have the agreement and redemption logs. The redemption payload (redacted) shows missing field `target_project` because the partner used an older UI flow. We should still be able to reassign.
sam (CloudOps): Steps I propose:
1) identify all resources impacted: `SELECT * FROM billing.events WHERE credit_id='cr-9921' OR partner_code='ACME-TRIAL-2024'`
2) reverse credit on our account via internal billing API: `POST /internal/billing/credits/reverse {"credit_id":"cr-9921"}`
3) reapply credit to `projects/acme-prod`
4) run attribution job to re-run cost allocation for June-July window
I'll own 1 and 2.
leo (Finance): Please run 1 and post a summary CSV. Finance will hold invoice adjustments until we confirm reapplication.
maria (Billing): Note: reversal needs sign-off from Partnerships and Finance. Also vendor ledger entries will show a short-term variance.
anya (Partnerships): I approve the reversal for partner ACME. Adding legal-approved note to ticket.
sam (CloudOps): Ran query, results: 6 events found, total credit applied to redwood-prod = $27,750 covering dates 2024-06-28 -> 2024-07-02. CSV: https://storage.redwood/finance/acme-credit-misalloc-1732100000.csv
leo (Finance): Nice. Maria, can you schedule the reversal? Also what's the impact to our reported cloud spend this month if reversed?
maria (Billing): Quick calc: it increases our reported cloud spend by $27.75k for June/July window. I'll update monthly close memo and adjust internal showback.
sam (CloudOps): Performed reversal request: `POST /internal/billing/credits/reverse` returned request_id=rev-1732 status=queued. ETA processing 2h.
billing-bot: Reversal queued: rev-1732. Will post status upon completion.
leo (Finance): After reversal completes, please reapply to acme project and ping ops-bot. We need the attribution job to produce corrected ledger before invoices go out.
anya (Partnerships): I'll notify Acme that the credit will be correctly applied and that invoices will reflect the fix. Apologize for noise.
maria (Billing): Once rev-1732 completes, I'll run `billing.recompute(attribution_window='2024-06-01:2024-07-05')` and share delta.
sam (CloudOps): Reapply job submitted: `POST /internal/billing/credits/apply {"credit_code":"ACME-TRIAL-2024","target_project":"projects/acme-prod"}` returned apply_id=app-884 status=queued.
billing-bot: apply_id=app-884 completed successfully. credit_id now mapped to projects/acme-prod.
maria (Billing): Recompute finished. Delta: Redwood internal pool spend +27750, Acme project credited -27750. Updated CSV: https://storage.redwood/finance/acme-credit-recompute-1732100000.csv
leo (Finance): Excellent. Closing loop. Action items: 1) anya  finalize partner UI fix to include `target_project` or explicit mapping (due: 2024-07-08). 2) sam  add validation to marketplace connector to reject missing target_project (done: hotfix deployed). 3) maria  confirm invoices regenerated and notify billing queue (due: 2024-07-03 18:00).
anya (Partnerships): Will prioritize the UI change and open a dev ticket.
leo (Finance): Thanks team. I'll flag this in monthly close note: "marketplace redemption mapping bug temporarily applied partner credit to internal pool; reversed and reapplied; ledger corrected." :memo: 
billing-bot: Ticket closed: ticket=BT-4581 resolution=credit-reallocated
